title: Tableau v1 → v4
summary: Rebuild the course's Tableau class step by step, exactly as in slides 99–112. Each step adds one of the canonical-form members, and the tests show why it's needed.

steps.title: v1: constructor and get
hints: Members: `unsigned taille_; double* tab_;`, allocated with `new double[taille]{}` (the `{}` zero-initialises).
`get` returns a `double&` so that `t.get(i) = x` writes into the array; throw `std::out_of_range` when `indice >= taille_`.

steps.title: v2: destructor
hints: `~Tableau() { delete[] tab_; }`: `delete[]` because the buffer was allocated with `new[]`.

steps.title: v3: copy constructor
hints: `Tableau(const Tableau& t)`: allocate a **new** buffer of `t.taille_` doubles and copy the elements one by one.
